articles.title: From expressways to airports: How infrastructure is reshaping real estate demand in India
articles.summary: Indian real estate investors focus on government infrastructure plans ('buy the map') rather than market trends, a strategy intensifying during election cycles. Over Rs.18,000 crore in new infrastructure projects have been announced. This approach underscores how national development initiatives significantly influence long-term investment and economic growth in India, providing key insights into strategic national planning.

articles.title: Rolls-Royce bets big on India—from jet engines to nuclear reactors via a BP playbook
articles.summary: Rolls-Royce has appointed Sashi Mukundan, former head of BP's India business, to lead a strategic expansion in the country. Mukundan brings 24 years of experience building energy partnerships across gas and fuel retail. This move signifies Rolls-Royce's commitment to strengthening its presence and fostering new collaborations within the Indian market, leveraging local expertise.

articles.title: UK, France to host defence ministers meeting on Hormuz
articles.summary: The UK and France are co-hosting a multinational meeting of defence ministers to discuss military plans for restoring trade flows through the crucial Strait of Hormuz. This initiative underscores international cooperation to ensure maritime security and uninterrupted global commerce in this vital waterway, a critical focus for strategic stability and defence operations for aspiring officers.

articles.title: China’s undersea cable threat raises $10T fears as Trump-Xi talks loom
articles.summary: Former U.S. intelligence officials warn that adversaries like China pose a significant threat to undersea cables. Targeting these vital communication lifelines could inflict devastating economic chaos on the U.S. economy. This highlights a critical vulnerability in global infrastructure, demanding enhanced national security measures and strategic deterrence to protect crucial digital connectivity from hostile state actors.

articles.title: DRDO only partially funded school in Dehradun, did not manage it; mgmt transferred to DAV trust to improve efficiency: Def society
articles.summary: The Defence Society clarified that DRDO only partially funded a Dehradun school, without managing its operations. To enhance efficiency and academic administration, the school's management has been transferred to the DAV trust. This move underlines a clear distinction in operational roles, ensuring DRDO remains focused on its core defence research and development mandate, while educational expertise handles institutional management.

articles.title: NFR revises timings of over 80 train services
articles.summary: Northeast Frontier Railway (NFR) has implemented major timing revisions for numerous Mail/Express, Passenger, DMU, and long-distance trains across its network. This update aims to enhance operational efficiency and punctuality, impacting travel for many passengers in the Northeast region. Aspirants should note such national infrastructure improvements, reflecting ongoing efforts in connectivity.

articles.title: Saturday Night Live Recap: Matt Damon Says ‘Hi’ To Your Mom
articles.summary: Actor Matt Damon recently hosted Saturday Night Live for his third time, a surprisingly infrequent occurrence given his acting versatility. Praised for his commitment in serious roles, Damon is also considered an underrated comedic talent. His return to the nationally recognized sketch show is noteworthy, highlighting his diverse range and surprising many that he hasn't hosted more often.
